title_original: The Film Comment Podcast: Fall 2026 Books
excerpt_original: Critics and scholars Erika Balsom and Genevieve Yue join to discuss their new books

blocks.text: On this week’s episode, Film Comment Editors Devika Girish and Clinton Krute invited two of their favorite writers, FC contributor Erika Balsom and FC Contributing Editor Genevieve Yue , to discuss their fascinating new books: Genevieve’s monograph Trains and Erika’s wide-ranging collection The Edges of Cinema: Essays on Twenty-First Century Film Culture . They dig into the subjects, inspirations, and writing processes for each book, as well the ways in which each author’s work grapples with contemporary definitions of documentary, the avant-garde, and much more.
